interactive.label: Help
interactive.tooltip: Explain detection recipes, ROI restriction, picking and measurement-container outputs.

interactive.label: Guide
interactive.tooltip: Work through the known-field demo with actual actions and image picking.

interactive.label: Add files
interactive.tooltip: Select photon or camera imaging files for preview and batch detection.

interactive.label: MMFDB datasets
interactive.tooltip: Select registered photon/camera datasets from the MMFDB catalog.

interactive.label: Remove file
interactive.tooltip: Remove the selected input from this detection batch.

interactive.label: Clear files
interactive.tooltip: Remove every input file from the batch without deleting the files.

interactive.label: name
interactive.tooltip: Stem the regions are stored under, so two detections of the same field can be compared instead of one replacing the other.

interactive.label: Analysis regions
interactive.tooltip: Restrict detection to named regions; empty or disabled regions use the entire frame.

interactive.label: threshold
interactive.tooltip: Intensity level; below 0 computes an Otsu level. For log/dog this is the minimum scale-normalised response instead, which does not follow the image units — read it off a run.

interactive.label: sigma
interactive.tooltip: Gaussian smoothing before thresholding. Smoothing is what stops a single noisy pixel becoming an object.

interactive.label: peak_footprint_size
interactive.tooltip: Square footprint side for the watershed's local-maxima seeds. Larger merges nearby seeds, which is how over-splitting is cured.

interactive.label: channel_field
interactive.tooltip: Photon-routing channels to sum, comma separated; blank selects every available detector channel.

interactive.label: frame
interactive.tooltip: Photon/image frame to analyze; -1 sums all available frames.

interactive.label: Write results
interactive.tooltip: Detect stores each label image and region table in its own measurement container; Preview always writes nothing.

interactive.label: Load demo
interactive.tooltip: Simulate/cache the known four-object photon field for validating a detection.

interactive.label: Preview
interactive.tooltip: Detect in the first input only and write nothing.

interactive.label: Detect
interactive.tooltip: Detect in every input; retain a run-table row even for empty or failed files.

interactive.label: Add picks
interactive.tooltip: Add fitted picked ellipses to the current detection and remeasure the regions.

interactive.label: Clear picks
interactive.tooltip: Forget every manually picked Gaussian proposal.

interactive.label: Export
interactive.tooltip: Export all files' measured region rows as CSV or TSV.

interactive.label: Save settings
interactive.tooltip: Save files, workflow deviations, routing, ROI composition and display state to JSON.

interactive.label: Load settings
interactive.tooltip: Restore the complete analysis configuration from JSON.

interactive.label: filter_regions
interactive.tooltip: Filter detected-region names; measurements and image picking remain available.

interactive.label: Run
interactive.tooltip: Review all input outcomes.

interactive.label: Region measurements
interactive.tooltip: Measured centroid, area, intensity and second moments of each region.
